parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Relative window: a positive integer followed by `h` or `d`, for example `24h` or `7d`. Provide either `period` or both `start` and `end`, never both.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Window start, ISO-8601. A value without a UTC offset is read as UTC. Must be used together with `end`.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Window end, ISO-8601. Must not be earlier than `start`, and the window must not exceed 92 days.

parameters.name: key_prefix
parameters.description: Prefix of the key to report on. Omit it to get the spend of the key you are authenticating with. Reporting on a different key requires a management key.

200.description: Total spend for the key over the requested window.

api_key_prefix.description: The requested key prefix, or null when it was omitted and the answer is your own key's spend.

spend.description: Total spend for the key over the window, in USD.

requests.description: Number of charged requests in the window.
